en: Black‑and‑white postcard showing a large outdoor Catholic ceremony with a richly decorated altar under an ornate arcade supported by columns. Numerous clergy in vestments and altar boys stand on the platform, facing a dense crowd of faithful in the foreground. In the background are trees and a substantial multi‑story building with balconies. Along the bottom margin, white capital letters identify the event as a diocesan Eucharistic congress in Trento, with a date in 1926.
